First of all, thank you for your support, it means a lot to us that after all these years you still want more Toko.

Over time we've made several improvements, from the Remix update, Japanese translation, voice acting, and soon a Spanish translation.

I just wanted to say that we're going to be revealing more details about the continuation of the story THIS SUMMER. The project is very much alive, and soon you'll see what we have in store.

Once again, thanks for your love and support, it means a ton to us!

notes.title: Dizzy Hearts Voice Acting Campaign
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30818914/cca1679adccd835367898b92663991cc402ea828.png[/img]

Dizzy Hearts is our very first conceptualized project, and started development a couple years ago. We funded it through Kickstarter in fact, but ran into delays, however with Mutiny!! out and our Mutiny!! writer working on the Adventure1 DLC, it felt the right to release Dizzy Hearts this year.

It's a visual novel, coming of age story where a girl from the sun-lit half of the world ventures into the moon-lit land of eternal night and elves. A yuri story, a steam safe game but with ecchi content.

This new Kickstarter is just for voice actors, we're teaming up with a pro recording studio Sound Cadence who've worked on several anime, the cast they've assembled for us on this project speaks for itself I think!

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/taosym/dizzy-hearts-va-project?ref=cy3n9r]Dizzy Hearts VA Project on Kickstarter[/url][/b]

[i](after Dizzy Hearts, our long awaited project, we go full speed ahead on The Reject Demon: Toko ch1)[/i]

notes.title: The Reject Demon: Toko plans
notes.notes:
People have been really interested in knowing what our plans are with The Reject Demon: Toko, specifically when are the next chapters coming out. Our current plan is to complete the remaining 3 chapters of Toko simultaneously. After that we'll have a period between each chapter release to let players play the new chapter and build suspense. Because each chapter of Toko has progressively steeper cliffhangers, we feel it's important to be able to deliver the remaining chapters promptly.

Our current project we've just completed is called The Stargazers, a short, self contained story coming out Nov 4th 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/445670

After that we are working on Dizzy Hearts, Dizzy Hearts is a project we kickstarted and a few of our Toko fans backed that project and would like to see that game release as much as see the remaining chapters of Toko. Which will release after Dizzy Hearts.

Regarding the Toko update, we're delayed on recasting our voice actress for Toko, beyond that, all other lines have been already recorded. We planned to release the new sprites along with this voice patch to allow fans to enjoy either, or both.

Thanks for being so patient, and we're excited for people to see more Toko soon! But we want to make sure that when we release the next chapter it won't be followed by another long wait.

notes.title: Voice Acting Preview Part 1
notes.notes:
Development studio Lupiesoft has been busy conjuring, summoning, and crafting away in order to deliver a devilishly delightful content update to The Reject Demon: Toko Chapter 0 - Prelude. The update which is slated to be released this spring, will not only include a fully-voiced downloadable content add-on, but will also treat fans to a free update featuring new full body hi-resolution sprites and game assets in glorious 1440p resolution!

The Reject Demon: Toko follows the story of Toko, a demon who has been kicked out of hell for failing to ferry human souls into the afterlife. Having been exiled to live among the humans on Earth, Toko finds herself becoming more and more human with each passing day.

Tormented and haunted by her hell-born past, Toko is taken in by the jubilant human Nadia, but she still faces a set of internal challenges that she must learn to overcome. The volume dial on her troubles, however, has only just started to scale up. The Reject Demon: Toko is about comedy, action, romance, and Hell’s sacred art of Rock n’ Roll!

For a reveal of the first set of voice actors lending their talent to The Reject Demon: Toko Chapter 0 - Prelude, click on the trailer below!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rn9Scn-SJTQ

notes.title: Important Upcoming Updates!
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who purchased The Reject Demon: Toko Ch 0!

We have some exciting news to share with you all:

- Firstly, Chapter 1 — Scherzo is coming later this year, we can't give an exact date to this, but these last few months we've been finalizing the outline for Chapters 1~3, our goal is to start writing Ch 1 in March, with further chapters to follow after that.

Chapter 1 is about Toko and her new band venturing into Middle Circle, where they meet The Psychopomps, A group of demons led by Ossetia, a girl with a strange dark power!

- In addition to this, the last few months we've been auditioning VAs for a voice acting patch, we're in the final stages of auditions right before we begin casting. As we start casting and recording we can share some more info and examples regarding that! The VA patch will be DLC, the final cost is not known yet but it won't be more expensive than the game itself. We're determining the price based on our costs.

- And finally, to come alongside the VA patch we're going to be creating a HiRes patch that will update the game up to a maximum possible resolution of 1440p, and include full body hi-res sprites. This will be free for everyone who bought and buys the game in the future!

Chapter 1 is about Toko and her new band venturing into Middle Circle, where they meet The Psychopomps, A group of demons led by Ossetia, a girl with a strange dark power!

- In addition to this, the last few months we've been auditioning VAs for a voice acting patch, we're in the final stages of auditions right before we begin casting. As we start casting and recording we can share some more info and examples regarding that! The VA patch will be DLC, the final cost is not known yet but it won't be more expensive than the game itself. We're determining the price based on our costs.

- And finally, to come alongside the VA patch we're going to be creating a HiRes patch that will update the game up to a maximum possible resolution of 1440p, and include full body hi-res sprites. This will be free for everyone who bought and buys the game in the future!

notes.title: Release and Onward!
notes.notes:
Toko launches in a little over a week now! Thank you everyone for your patience; Toko is now done~!

That said, we have a few things planned after release. People were interested in seeing things like Steam cards, voice acting, and more. Following release, we are going to be working on a set of Steam trading cards for Toko as well as a patch that will bump the default resolution from 720p up to a scalable resolution of 1440p! This will be a free release for everyone who got bought the game. (Please note: if space or RAM is an issue for you, then you can opt to not download this patch). 

In addition to this, we are pursuing a voice acting patch for the game. If this interests you, let us know! Voice acting is on the expensive side and our goal is to have high quality voice acting that fits each character. Understandably, if we can't achieve that goal then we'd rather not have the voice acting. That said,  we will be beginning auditions for the game very soon. There is no ETA when this patch might be out but we plan to show samples as we finalize the cast.
